mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bgxt_jyjg WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bgxt_jyjg WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND IFNULL(TRIM(jyjg), '') = ''

SELECT jg.xmdm, xm.xmzwmc, jg.jyjg FROM bgxt_jyjg jg LEFT JOIN sys_jyxm xm ON jg.xmdm=xm.xmdm WHERE jg.brxx_id=#{brxxId} AND jg.jyjg REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' AND CAST(jg.jyjg AS DECIMAL) < 0 LIMIT 10

SELECT jg.xmdm AS code, jg.zhid, COALESCE(xm.xmzwmc, jg.xmzwmc, '') AS name, COALESCE(xm.xmdw, jg.jldw, '') AS unit, COALESCE(jg.jyjg, '') AS result, COALESCE(jg.ckz, '') AS refRange, jg.bjzdx AS criticalLow, jg.bjzgx AS criticalHigh, COALESCE(jg.gdbj, '') AS highLowFlag, xm.xmid AS xmid FROM bgxt_jyjg jg LEFT JOIN ( SELECT xmdm, xmzwmc, xmdw, xmid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY xmdm ORDER BY xmid) as rn FROM sys_jyxm_full ) xm ON jg.xmdm = xm.xmdm AND xm.rn = 1 WHERE jg.brxx_id = #{brxxId} ORDER BY jg.id

SELECT jg.xmdm, jg.xmzwmc, jg.jyjg, IFNULL(jg.jldw, mx2.xmdw) AS jldw, IFNULL(jg.ckz,'') AS ckz, jg.gdbj, jg.bjzdx, jg.bjzgx FROM bgxt_jyjg jg LEFT JOIN ( SELECT xmdm, MAX(xmdw) AS xmdw FROM bgxt_xmzh_mx GROUP BY xmdm ) mx2 ON jg.xmdm = mx2.xmdm WHERE jg.brxx_id=#{brxxId} ORDER BY jg.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_jyjg (brxx_id, xmdm, xmzwmc, jyjg, jldw, ckz, ckzgx, ckzdx, bjzgx, bjzdx, gdbj, cjmxid, czri) SELECT #{brxxId}, COALESCE(jf.xmdm, CAST(#{xmid} AS CHAR)), COALESCE(jf.xmzwmc, ''), #{jyjg}, COALESCE(jf.xmdw, ''), #{ckz}, #{ckzgx}, #{ckzdx}, #{bjzgx}, #{bjzdx}, #{gdbj}, #{cjmxid}, NOW() FROM sys_jyxm_full jf WHERE jf.xmid = #{xmid} LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO bgxt_jyjglog (brxx_id, xmid, jyjg, gdbj, ckz, czri) SELECT jg.brxx_id, jf.xmid, jg.jyjg, jg.gdbj, jg.ckz, NOW() FROM bgxt_jyjg jg JOIN sys_jyxm_full jf ON jg.xmdm = jf.xmdm WHERE jg.brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.delete: DELETE jg FROM bgxt_jyjg jg JOIN sys_jyxm_full jf ON jg.xmdm = jf.xmdm WHERE jg.brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND jf.xmid = #{xmid} AND jg.id NOT IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM bgxt_jyjg WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} GROUP BY xmdm)
